_about: Phase 2 UGC slice. Beats from library/fixtures/ugc-01/card.json. Scenes are drawn in engine/src/jobs/ugc-01/scenes/ (a 16:9 still in a 9:16 window, a camera that pushes in and follows the pointer); captions are drawn by the scenes in the caption band (82 to 93 percent of the height), not by the shared pill.

shots.move: push in 2.4 to 2.9; a comment card drops in at frame 0 and takes a like tap
shots.sound: phone-buzz at 0.0, impact-soft as the first caption lands, finger-tap-like on the heart, riser into the cut

shots.focal_point: sidebar item, then the New button
shots.move: pointer path from cursor.json; click-through swap; camera follows the pointer; glow on New
shots.sound: whip on the cut, finger-tap on the click, small-whoosh on the camera follow, toast-pop on the hover

shots.move: camera settles on the title, ring lands on it
shots.sound: text-swish as the caption arrives, success-chime as the ring lands

shots.move: wipe to the light stage, offer line, wordmark
shots.sound: offer-sting on the offer, logo-sting on the wordmark
